name: MoEDAL-MAPP
summary: MoEDAL-MAPP is based in underground tunnels near LHCb at CERN LHC Point 8. Its parent experiment is MoEDAL; magnetic-monopole sensitivity does not automatically make all MoEDAL running a dark-matter search.
detection_principle: MAPP uses multilayer low-threshold scintillator units to detect weak ionization and related modules to study weakly coupled long-lived particles. This MoEDAL extension has dark-sector targets distinct from the original monopole search.

results.summary: The updated dark-pion paper gives HL-LHC MAPP-1 projections with background assumptions, rather than exclusions.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
